info_need: Find the report of a restriction fragment length variant detected with the PstI enzyme, lying between the VK21 and St14 markers at the distal end of the long arm of the X chromosome.
Which voltage-clamp study of endplate currents in amphibian sartorius muscle concluded that memantine blocks acetylcholine receptor channels in both their open and closed states?

Find the cattle experiment with cloned Trypanosoma congolense and T. brucei showing that when two parasite clones are given together, the variant-specific antibody response to one of them is suppressed.

Find the surgeon's technique report on replacing the aortic root with a valved conduit and reattaching the coronary arteries in Marfan syndrome, with about 1% operative mortality in more than 170 patients.

Which Taiwanese evaluation compared three latex agglutination kits and one hemagglutination kit against the coagulase test on methicillin-resistant and susceptible staphylococcal isolates, finding StaphAurex less specific?

Find the study showing that CART-containing axons synapse on most pro-TRH cell bodies in the PVN and that injecting CART into the brain ventricles prevents the drop in pro-TRH caused by food deprivation.
Which ELISA study of 394 sera reported that antibodies to the linker histone H1 are highly specific for lupus and follow clinical flares better than anti-dsDNA?
Find the 1959 experiment testing whether racemic carnitine stops the spontaneous twitching of isolated frog sartorius preparations bathed in saline.

Which study of three CCD-linked pore substitutions in the skeletal muscle calcium-release channel RyR1, co-expressed with SERCA1a in HEK-293 cells, found that mixing in wild-type subunits restores calcium responsiveness but only partly restores release amplitude?

Find the questionnaire study of 90 female patients with borderline personality disorder or social phobia in Germany and Switzerland, in which seeing discrimination as less justified predicted higher self-esteem.
Which study measured blood-cell telomere length in 41 people with cri du chat deletions that remove one TERT copy, finding only mildly shorter telomeres that diverged more with age?

Find the KSHV study in which alanine substitutions in the carboxy-terminal region of the latency-associated nuclear antigen impaired its chromosome attachment and, together with weakened amino-terminal binding, reduced episome maintenance.

Which pharmaceutical case study of a drug substance with 5 anhydrous and 66 solvated crystal forms designed desolvation-based screens at high temperature to confirm that the development form is the most stable?
Find the review of off-label anti-CD20 antibody therapy for pemphigus and other blistering skin diseases when steroids or standard immunosuppression fail.
Find the report from Korea that identified the fungus causing white mycelium and chasmothecia on Cirsium japonicum leaves, using ITS and 28S rDNA sequences matching P. fusca.

Which Dutch study measured whether the labelled amounts of retinol, ascorbic acid and folate in supplements, fortified foods and baby formula were actually present, and what fraction is available for absorption?
Find the small study of 53 men biopsied for suspected malignancy in Bulgaria in which circulating 25OHD measured by HPLC was lower with higher Gleason grade and differed by season.
Which study genotyped 1,850 consecutive autopsy cases in Japan and linked exome-chip variants of the TAP2 peptide pump gene to granuloma-confirmed TB?
Find the echo study in 85 heart failure patients with LVEF of 40% or less that tested MAVIR as a marker of severe secondary MR, with a cutoff of 1.02, and followed patients after MitraClip.

Which comparison of 136 toothless lower-jaw patients found that two-implant attachment-retained prostheses needed fewer adjustments and relines than conventional complete dentures, with more abutment loosening on external-connection fixtures?
Find the study measuring serum levels of the DNA repair enzyme APE1/Ref-1 by ELISA in kidney, liver and bile duct cancers and linking high cytoplasmic staining to shorter disease-free survival.
Which study combined density functional theory with experiments to show that zinc doping of tin sulfide improves room-temperature methanol sensing down to 100 ppb?
Find the analysis showing that age-adjusted chlamydial infection rates in active-duty Army personnel were nearly twice civilian rates in 2019, while gonococcal rates were lower.
Which study recycled calcium sulfate deposits washed off evaporator walls into rod-shaped calcite crystals by bubbling CO2 through a gluconate eluate with polyethylene glycol?
Find the THP-1 study using immuno-spin trapping, EPR and fluorescent probes to show hydroxyl radical production and malondialdehyde formation as monocytes mature into macrophages.
Find the commentary arguing that community investment should be used to change social determinants of heart disease risk rather than only documenting them.
Which study made lipid nanoparticles combining a cyclosporin-derived ionizable lipid with MCU siRNA to block mitochondrial pore opening in bleomycin models of lung fibrosis?
Find the coal-mine dust study that screened 12 surfactants and found that pairing AES with AEO-9 most improved water wetting of brown coal dust.
